news.title: STAT+: HIV resurgence is feared as global funding to combat the disease falls 18%
news.summary: The world risks a resurgence of the HIV epidemic after international financing to combat the disease suffered a “profound shock” last year, according to a new report from UNAIDS.

news.title: STAT+: Pharma’s drug spending deflection
news.summary: Job lock, surging prescription drug costs, No Surprises Act update, and more from STAT's Health Care Inc.

news.title: STAT+: Sarepta names Michael Severino, former Tessera CEO, as new chief executive
news.summary: The beleaguered Sarepta Therapeutics named Michael Severino, who previously led Tessera Therapeutics, as its new CEO.

news.title: STAT+: Pharmalittle: We’re reading about a U.S. peptide panel’s votes, Amgen scuffling with the FDA, and more
news.summary: An FDA panel recommended that compounding pharmacies be allowed to make two more peptides, a step toward RFK Jr.'s goal to make them more available

news.title: STAT+: Ahead of hearing, FDA questions the efficacy of Capricor’s Duchenne drug
news.summary: Ahead of a hearing, the FDA raised questions about the benefits of a Duchenne treatment from Capricor Therapeutics, another twist for the rare disease drug.

news.title: A trend that isn’t fading, ultra-processed baby foods
news.summary: An FDA advisory panel serves some peptide wins, a measles record, and more health news from Morning Rounds

news.title: STAT+: RA Capital backs upstart rival to Ultragenyx and Ionis in rare brain disease
news.summary: Oak Hill Bio, a new company backed by RA Capital and other investors, will take on Ultragenyx and Ionis in developing an Angelman syndrome medicine.

news.title: Opinion: E-bikes, e-scooters are a burgeoning pediatric public health emergency
news.summary: “Emergency departments across America report dramatic increases in serious injuries from e-bikes and e-scooters,” write CHOP’s J. Todd R. Lawrence and Madison A. Kesler.

news.title: STAT+: As some medical schools embrace RFK Jr.’s nutrition push, they deftly sidestep MAHA priorities
news.summary: Even as some medical schools heed health secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr.’s call for more nutrition education, several told STAT that they plan to steer clear of topics that aren’t…

news.title: Opinion: How midwives like me can help fight medical misinformation
news.summary: “I have come to believe that changing a mind is rarely the point. Planting a seed is,” writes nurse-midwife Mara Evans.

news.title: STAT+: Argenx to buy Forte Biosciences for $2.2B
news.summary: Argenx plans to buy Forte Biosciences for $2.2 billion, expanding its pipeline of drugs that could treat multiple autoimmune diseases.

news.title: Industry survey finds MA enrollees have lower out-of-pocket costs than those in traditional Medicare
news.summary: A new analysis finds that Medicare Advantage enrollees spend less on average than those in the traditional program, but report similar satisfaction levels.

news.title: Intermountain Health acquiring interests in 2 Idaho hospitals for $795M
news.summary: The nonprofit would become the sole owner of the 88-bed Idaho Falls Community Hospital and share ownership of the 38-bed Mountain View Hospital. It has been a minority investor in both since 2023.

news.title: Salesforce lands $1.6B Veteran Affairs deal to integrate AI into healthcare workflows
news.summary: The agreement aims to create a “unified foundation across the department, equipping VA employees with trusted agentic AI, integrated data, and advanced collaboration tools that can reduce administrative friction and give staff more time to serve Veterans," the VA said.

news.title: As AI scribe adoption grows, researchers at Suki challenge the industry's quality playbook
news.summary: As adoption of AI ambient scribe technology rapidly grows, the healthcare industry's standard method for evaluating clinical AI notes may be fundamentally flawed, failing to detect significant errors in patient notes.

news.title: Flourish Health secures $26M to scale intensive youth mental healthcare
news.summary: The startup provides an in-home care model to help child and young adult patients with serious complex mental health needs.

news.title: HaloMD's Patrick Velliky explains why No Surprises Act IDR enforcement matters
news.summary: A HaloMD executive examines IDR nonpayment, enforcement gaps and what is at stake for providers and patients.

news.title: New university initiative offers screening, referrals for endometriosis
news.summary: The partnership, led by a national provider of endometriosis care and an awareness nonprofit, offers colleges free educational resources, screening tools and referral pathways.

news.title: Tenet Healthcare shrugs off ACA headwinds with sweeping Q2 outperformance, boosts 2026 guidance
news.summary: Bucking a trend set by its for-profit peers, the company outpaced the margin hit of substantial uninsured volume growth and boosted its 2026 guidance.

news.title: Inside Aetna's investments to build provider trust
news.summary: Addressing healthcare's biggest challenges will require payers and providers working together.

news.title: Industry Voices—The new model for rural healthcare is already taking shape
news.summary: Community health plans are uniquely positioned to bring together technology and community partnerships to address local rural care needs, writes Tom Doran, president of Highmark Health Plan.

news.title: HCA Healthcare's H1 ACA volume dropoffs 'almost one for one' shifted to uninsurance
news.summary: The for-profit health system's executives said the number of patients who dropped health insurance exchanges was within expectations, but that they were surprised almost none of those patients shifted to commercial coverage.

news.title: OpenAI makes Health in ChatGPT widely available, moving deeper into consumer health
news.summary: OpenAI on Thursday made its Health in ChatGPT feature broadly available, enabling U.S. users to connect its artificial intelligence chatbot with medical records and wellness apps.

news.title: RA Capital launches rare disease company Oak Hill Bio onto Nasdaq via SPAC
news.summary: Rare disease biotech Oak Hill is headed to the Nasdaq through a SPAC merger with RA Capital-sponsored Research Alliance Corporation III (RACC) to fund a rare genetic disease candidate.

news.title: MapLight shares sink on mixed phase 2 schizophrenia readout
news.summary: MapLight Therapeutics’ stock plummeted more than 60% this morning after the neuro outfit dropped mixed results for a phase 2 trial of its experimental schizophrenia treatment.

news.title: Apnimed aspires for up to $160M IPO as sleep apnea pill launch nears
news.summary: Apnimed has detailed its plans for an initial public offering, with the biotech intending to raise as much as $160 million to fund the launch of its sleep apnea pill.

news.title: FDA approves Freenome colorectal cancer blood test to be marketed by Abbott
news.summary: The FDA has approved Freenome’s new blood-based colorectal cancer test, SimpleScreen CRC, which Abbott will exclusively market in the U.S.

news.title: InnoCare’s oral TYK2 inhibitor clears phase 3 psoriasis test
news.summary: InnoCare Pharma announced Monday that its oral tyrosine kinase 2 (TYK2) inhibitor fadeucravacitinib met the primary endpoint in a phase 3 trial of adults with moderate-to-severe plaque psoriasis.

news.title: After missed endpoint, Gossamer and Chiesi pull the plug on PAH drug collaboration
news.summary: After signing a deal worth up to $486 million with Italian biopharma Chiesi to develop its pulmonary arterial hypertension (PAH) candidate seralutinib in 2024, Gossamer Bio has ended the collaboration and licensing agreement.

news.title: Legend Biotech CEO abruptly steps down without permanent replacement
news.summary: In a sudden leadership shift, Legend Biotech announced that its CEO, Ying Huang, Ph.D., resigned on Friday, with no permanent replacement yet named.

news.title: Labcorp launches DTC ‘Genetic Health Panel’ to seek out multiple diseases
news.summary: Labcorp is launching the Marker by Labcorp Genetic Health Panel, a new direct-to-consumer genetic testing tool that analyzes 163 genes to determine patients’ risk of over 100 hereditary health conditions.

news.title: Argenx acquires Forte for $2.2B to get hands on phase 2-stage vitiligo drug
news.summary: Argenx is spending $2.2 billion to absorb Forte Biosciences for its phase 2-stage vitiligo and celiac disease drug.

news.title: AstraZeneca execs ‘very confident’ in homegrown ADC pipeline despite scrapping 2 candidates
news.summary: AstraZeneca executives told Fierce they are “very confident” in the pharma’s in-house pipeline of ADCs despite scrapping two candidates that underperformed in the clinic.

news.title: Amgen sheds around 40 staffers amid continuing struggles
news.summary: Amgen has laid off around 40 employees as part of “organizational changes” meant to better align operations with the company’s strategic objectives, Fierce has learned.

news.title: Fierce Biotech Layoff Tracker 2026: Amgen sheds staff; Clinuvel cuts fifth of workforce
news.summary: As always, if you know of layoffs occurring at a biotech, please reach out to the Fierce Biotech editorial team.

papers.title: ClinFusion: A Vision-Centric Multimodal LLM System for Holistic Medical Understanding
papers.summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) hold immense potential to revolutionize clinical practice, yet deploying them in the medical domain is fundamentally a vision-centric challenge: models must absorb knowledge from heterogeneous 2D and 3D medical images, and evaluation protocols must align with radiologists' clinical practice and provide an accurate, fine-grained and factualness-driven assessment.
